scb.grammar_1: Present tense of reflexive verbs related to house chores (levantarse, ducharse, lavarse, vestirse, acostarse)
scb.grammar_2: The verb gustar (me gusta / no me gusta / le gusta + infinitive)
scb.register: informal spoken (family negotiation) → formal written recommendation
scb.transfer_goal: Write a formal recommendation to a household committee proposing a fair weekly chore schedule, with at least three reasons drawn from the negotiation
success_criteria: Use at least three reflexive verbs in present tense correctly
Use gustar + infinitive to express at least two preferences or complaints
Negotiate a specific chore assignment for each person in the scenario
Produce the Paso 5 class synthesis: En nuestra casa ideal, [person] se encarga de [chore] porque...
Write a formal recommendation using formal opening phrases and hedging-to-formal register shifts

adb.confirmed_complication: role_asymmetry — Student A (parent, does most chores) and Student B (teenager, does very few) negotiate a fair redistribution using gustar to express preferences and reflexive verbs to describe daily routines. The structural power imbalance (parental authority vs. teenage dependence) shapes the negotiation.
adb.confirmed_outcome: A negotiated chore distribution with at least 3 assigned chores (one per person minimum), a fairness rating with justification, and a Paso 5 public commitment synthesis sentence.
adb.gap_summary: Student A holds a full chore schedule (6 chores) and schedule details; Student B holds a light chore load and after-school activity constraints plus a cooking preference A does not know about. Neither can produce the full negotiated plan without the other's information. A must discover B's preferences using gustar; B must reveal schedule constraints using reflexive verbs.
